metadata.goal: bounded method sweep for the active 6-state simple-support background path

methods.name: baseline_old_path
methods.key_idea: Reference rescue-local secant continuation on the current single-domain profile mesh.
methods.numerical_change: None; this is the control path used to measure the present ceiling.

methods.main_failure_mode: maximum nodes exceeded with strong right-edge concentration
methods.recommendation: Reference only; this path stays at the old 4.3434 / 4.3440 MPa ceiling/failure pair.

methods.name: quadratic_predictor_bundle
methods.key_idea: Use a three-point quadratic profile-space predictor before falling back to the usual local seeds.
methods.numerical_change: Predictor only: stronger reuse of the last three converged states on the same fixed mesh.

anchor_result.message: The algorithm converged to the desired accuracy.

highest_success.message: The algorithm converged to the desired accuracy.

methods.recommendation: Not worth pursuing on its own; predictor strengthening gives only a marginal lift.

methods.name: arc_like_state_norm_control
methods.key_idea: Approximate pseudo-arclength by advancing along the last extended-state tangent and adapting the step factor after failures.
methods.numerical_change: State/load tangent step control on the same single-domain mesh, with post-failure factor halving.

anchor_result.message: The algorithm converged to the desired accuracy.

highest_success.message: The algorithm converged to the desired accuracy.

methods.recommendation: Not worth pursuing alone; the arc-like surrogate still stalls near the old ceiling band.

methods.name: u_z_scaled_state
methods.key_idea: Rescale the dominant barrier variable u_z inside the nonlinear BVP solve while keeping the physical state unchanged.
methods.numerical_change: State representation only: fixed diagonal scaling with factor 20 on u_z.

anchor_result.message: The algorithm converged to the desired accuracy.

highest_success.message: The algorithm converged to the desired accuracy.

methods.recommendation: Continue as a secondary path; scaling helps materially, but it is weaker than the domain-split formulation.

methods.name: bulk_edge_domain_split
methods.key_idea: Solve the same 6-state BVP on two coupled subdomains so the right-edge layer can be resolved separately from the bulk.
methods.numerical_change: Multiple-shooting-like formulation with explicit bulk/right-edge matching at x=0.97.

first_failure.message: The maximum number of mesh nodes is exceeded.

methods.recommendation: Not worth continuing if the split formulation cannot even recover 4.3434 MPa.
